spare_parts_and_inventory.name: QrySpareParts_in
spare_parts_and_inventory.sql: PARAMETERS [ادخل السنة] Long, [ ادخل رقم الشهر المراد إخرج تقريره] Long; SELECT [ادخل السنة] AS [year], Store_SP.type, Sum(Store_SP.count_in) AS SumOfcount_in, [ ادخل رقم الشهر المراد إخرج تقريره] AS [Month] FROM Store_SP WHERE Store_SP.in_date >= DateSerial([ادخل السنة],[ ادخل رقم الشهر المراد إخرج تقريره], 1) AND Store_SP.in_date < DateAdd( "m", 1, DateSerial([ادخل السنة],[ ادخل رقم الشهر المراد إخرج تقريره], 1) ) GROUP BY Store_SP.type;  --------------------------------------------------

spare_parts_and_inventory.name: QrySpareParts_NOW
spare_parts_and_inventory.sql: SELECT failure_points.model, Store_SP.type, Sum(Nz(Store_SP.count_in, 0)) AS SumOfcount_in FROM failure_points INNER JOIN Store_SP ON failure_points.type = Store_SP.type GROUP BY failure_points.model, Store_SP.type ORDER BY failure_points.model, Store_SP.type;  --------------------------------------------------

spare_parts_and_inventory.name: QrySpareParts_out
spare_parts_and_inventory.sql: PARAMETERS [Start_Date] DateTime, [End_Date] DateTime; SELECT Year([out_date]) AS السنة, Month([out_date]) AS الشهر, Store_SP.type AS [قطعة الغيار], Sum(Nz(Store_SP.count_in,0))*-1 AS [مجموع قطع الغيار المنصرفة] FROM Store_SP WHERE Store_SP.out_date >= DateValue([Start_Date]) AND Store_SP.out_date < DateAdd( "d", 1, DateValue([End_Date]) ) GROUP BY Year([out_date]), Month([out_date]), Store_SP.type ORDER BY Store_SP.type, Year([out_date]), Month([out_date]);  --------------------------------------------------

spare_parts_and_inventory.name: QrySpareParts_out_dateperiod
spare_parts_and_inventory.sql: PARAMETERS [Start Date] DateTime, [End Date] DateTime; SELECT Year([out_date]) & '/' & Month([out_date]) & '/' & Day([out_date]) AS [Date], Store_SP.type, ConcatenateNotes(Store_SP.type, DateValue([out_date])) AS Notes, Sum(Nz(Store_SP.count_in, 0)) * -1 AS [العدد الكلي للقطع], Sum(IIf(Store_SP.serial Like "*مجاني*", Nz(Store_SP.count_in, 0), 0)) * -1 AS [عدد القطع بدون مقابل], ( Sum(Nz(Store_SP.count_in, 0)) * -1 - Sum(IIf(Store_SP.serial Like "*مجاني*", Nz(Store_SP.count_in, 0), 0)) * -1 ) AS [عدد القطع بمقابل] FROM Store_SP WHERE Store_SP.out_date >= DateValue([Start Date]) AND Store_SP.out_date < DateAdd("d", 1, DateValue([End Date])) GROUP BY Year([out_date]) & '/' & Month([out_date]) & '/' & Day([out_date]), Store_SP.type, ConcatenateNotes(Store_SP.type, DateValue([out_date])) ORDER BY Year([out_date]) & '/' & Month([out_date]) & '/' & Day([out_date]) DESC , Store_SP.type;  --------------------------------------------------

spare_parts_and_inventory.name: QrySpareParts_out_Detailed
spare_parts_and_inventory.sql: PARAMETERS [ادخل السنة المراد إخرج تقريرها] Long, [ادخل رقم الشهر المراد إخرج تقريره] Long; SELECT DISTINCT Q.type AS [قطعة الغيار], Q.out_date AS [تاريخ التغيير], Q.notes AS [رقم الماكينة], Q.count_in * -1 AS [عدد قطع الغيار], Q.Serial AS [تفاصيل الدفع], Q.الجزء_الثالث, IIf(Q.Serial Like "*مجاني*", "بدون مقابل", "بمقابل") AS [بمقابل/بدون مقابل], Assets.Owner AS [اسم العميل] FROM Query_ExtractThirdPart AS Q INNER JOIN Assets ON Q.الجزء_الثالث = Assets.bkcode WHERE Q.out_date >= DateSerial( [ادخل السنة المراد إخرج تقريرها], [ادخل رقم الشهر المراد إخرج تقريره], 1 ) AND Q.out_date < DateAdd( "m", 1, DateSerial( [ادخل السنة المراد إخرج تقريرها], [ادخل رقم الشهر المراد إخرج تقريره], 1 ) ) ORDER BY Q.type;  --------------------------------------------------

spare_parts_and_inventory.name: QrySpareParts_out_Detailed_N
spare_parts_and_inventory.sql: SELECT Store_SP.type AS [قطعة الغيار], Store_SP.out_date AS [تاريخ التغيير], Store_SP.notes AS [رقم الماكينة], Store_SP.count_in * -1 AS [عدد قطع الغيار], Store_SP.Serial AS [تفاصيل الدفع], IIf( InStr(Store_SP.serial, "-") > 0, Left(Store_SP.serial, InStr(Store_SP.serial, "-") - 1), Store_SP.serial ) AS [بمقابل/بدون مقابل] FROM Store_SP WHERE Store_SP.out_date >= Forms!frm_query_SP!txtfromdate AND Store_SP.out_date < DateAdd( "d", 1, Forms!frm_query_SP!txttodate ) ORDER BY Store_SP.type, Store_SP.out_date;  --------------------------------------------------

spare_parts_and_inventory.name: QrySpareParts_out_month
spare_parts_and_inventory.sql: PARAMETERS [EnterMonth] Long; SELECT Year([out_date]) AS [Year], Month([out_date]) AS [Month], Store_SP.type, Sum(Nz(Store_SP.count_in,0))*-1 AS SumOfcount_in_Neg FROM Store_SP WHERE (((Store_SP.out_date)>=DateSerial(Year(Date()),[EnterMonth],1) And (Store_SP.out_date)<DateAdd("m",1,DateSerial(Year(Date()),[EnterMonth],1)))) GROUP BY Year([out_date]), Month([out_date]), Store_SP.type ORDER BY Year([out_date]), Month([out_date]), Store_SP.type;  --------------------------------------------------

spare_parts_and_inventory.name: QrySpareParts_out_monthly
spare_parts_and_inventory.sql: PARAMETERS [Enter Year] Long, [Enter Month] Long; SELECT Store_SP.type, ConcatenateNotesMonth(Store_SP.type, [Enter Year], [Enter Month]) AS Notes, Year(Store_SP.out_date) & "/" & Month(Store_SP.out_date) AS Expr2, Sum(Nz(Store_SP.count_in, 0)) * -1 AS SumOfcount_in, failure_points.price, Sum(Nz(Store_SP.count_in, 0)) * -1 * Nz(failure_points.price, 0) AS TotalPrice, failure_points.fees FROM failure_points INNER JOIN Store_SP ON failure_points.type = Store_SP.type WHERE Store_SP.out_date >= DateSerial([Enter Year], [Enter Month], 1) AND Store_SP.out_date < DateAdd( "m", 1, DateSerial([Enter Year], [Enter Month], 1) ) GROUP BY Store_SP.type, ConcatenateNotesMonth(Store_SP.type, [Enter Year], [Enter Month]), Year(Store_SP.out_date) & "/" & Month(Store_SP.out_date), failure_points.price, failure_points.fees ORDER BY Year(Store_SP.out_date) & "/" & Month(Store_SP.out_date), Store_SP.type;  --------------------------------------------------

spare_parts_and_inventory.name: QrySpareParts_out_or
spare_parts_and_inventory.sql: SELECT Store_SP.type, Sum(Store_SP.count_in) AS SumOfcount_in, Year([out_date]) AS [year], Month([out_date]) AS [Month], tbl_sp_prices.price, [SumOfcount_in]*-[price] AS [Total Price] FROM tbl_sp_prices INNER JOIN Store_SP ON tbl_sp_prices.sp = Store_SP.type GROUP BY Store_SP.type, Year([out_date]), Month([out_date]), tbl_sp_prices.price HAVING (((Year([out_date]))=[ادخل السنة]) AND ((Month([out_date]))=[ ادخل رقم الشهر المراد إخرج تقريره]));  --------------------------------------------------

financials_and_payments.name: Qry_D210_sales
financials_and_payments.sql: SELECT payments.pos_number AS [مسلسل الماكينة], payments.policy AS [اسم النشاط على النظام], payments.procedure_maker AS [موظف خدمه العملاء مسئول البيع], payments.payment_date AS [تاريخ الإيداع], payments.payment_amount AS المبلغ, payments.payer AS [أسم المودع], payments.ref_num AS [رقم القسيمة], Temp_transfer.Transfer_Date AS [تاريخ تسليم الماكينه للعميل], payments.payment_reason AS [سبب الدفع] FROM payments LEFT JOIN Temp_transfer ON payments.pos_number = Temp_transfer.NewPOS WHERE (((payments.pos_number) Like "5F*") AND ((payments.payment_amount)>=6500)) ORDER BY Temp_transfer.Transfer_Date;  --------------------------------------------------

financials_and_payments.name: Qry_D230_sales
financials_and_payments.sql: SELECT payments.pos_number AS [مسلسل الماكينة], payments.policy AS [اسم النشاط على النظام], payments.procedure_maker AS [موظف خدمه العملاء مسئول البيع], payments.payment_date AS [تاريخ الإيداع], payments.payment_amount AS المبلغ, payments.payer AS [أسم المودع], payments.ref_num AS [رقم القسيمة], payments.payment_reason AS [سبب الدفع], QryTempTransfer_first.FirstOfTransfer_Date AS [تاريخ التسليم] FROM payments INNER JOIN QryTempTransfer_first ON payments.pos_number = QryTempTransfer_first.NewPOS WHERE (((payments.pos_number) Like "233*") AND ((payments.payment_amount)>=7000));  --------------------------------------------------

financials_and_payments.sql: SELECT payments.pos_number AS [مسلسل الماكينة], payments.policy AS [اسم النشاط على النظام], payments.procedure_maker AS [موظف خدمه العملاء مسئول البيع], payments.payment_date AS [تاريخ الإيداع], payments.payment_amount AS المبلغ, payments.payer AS [أسم المودع], payments.ref_num AS [رقم القسيمة], payments.payment_reason AS [سبب الدفع], QryTempTransfer_first.FirstOfTransfer_Date AS [تاريخ التسليم] FROM payments INNER JOIN QryTempTransfer_first ON payments.pos_number = QryTempTransfer_first.NewPOS WHERE (((payments.pos_number) Like "3k*" Or (payments.pos_number) Like "3d*") AND ((payments.payment_amount)>=7000));  --------------------------------------------------

financials_and_payments.name: QryInstallmentBase
financials_and_payments.sql: SELECT t.pos AS [رقم الماكينة], Max(p.payer) AS [اسم العميل], t.installments AS [مدة القسط], 3000 AS [المقدم المدفوع], t.unitprice AS [قيمة الماكينة بدون فوائد], t.finalunitprice AS [قيمة الماكينة بعد الفوائد], t.monthlyinstallmentprice AS [قيمة القسط الشهري], Min( IIf( p.payment_reason Like "*قسط*" And Not p.payment_reason Like "مقدم*", p.send_date, Null ) ) AS FirstSendDate, Int( Nz( Sum( IIf( p.payment_reason Like "*قسط*" And Not p.payment_reason Like "مقدم*", p.payment_amount, 0 ) ), 0) / t.monthlyinstallmentprice ) AS PaidInstallments, Nz( Sum( IIf( p.payment_reason Like "*قسط*" And Not p.payment_reason Like "مقدم*", p.payment_amount, 0 ) ), 0) AS [قيمة الاقساط المدفوعة], t.installments - Int( Nz( Sum( IIf( p.payment_reason Like "*قسط*" And Not p.payment_reason Like "مقدم*", p.payment_amount, 0 ) ), 0) / t.monthlyinstallmentprice ) AS [عدد الأقساط المتبقية], Nz( (SELECT Sum(p4.payment_amount) FROM payments AS p4 WHERE p4.pos_number = t.pos), 0) AS [اجمالي ما تم دفعه], t.finalunitprice - (3000 + Nz( Sum( IIf( p.payment_reason Like "*قسط*" And Not p.payment_reason Like "مقدم*", p.payment_amount, 0 ) ), 0)) AS [المبلغ المتبقي] FROM tblinstallments AS t LEFT JOIN payments AS p ON t.pos = p.pos_number GROUP BY t.pos, t.installments, t.unitprice, t.finalunitprice, t.monthlyinstallmentprice ORDER BY t.pos;  --------------------------------------------------

financials_and_payments.name: QryInstallmentFollowups_old
financials_and_payments.sql: SELECT payments.pos_number AS [رقم الماكينة], Max(payments.payer) AS [اسم العميل], tblinstallments.installments AS [مدة القسط], 3000 AS [المقدم المدفوع], tblinstallments.unitprice AS [قيمة الماكينة بدون فوائد], tblinstallments.finalunitprice AS [قيمة الماكينة بعد الفوائد], tblinstallments.monthlyinstallmentprice AS [قيمة القسط الشهري], Count([payments].[payment_date])-1 AS [عدد الأقساط المدفوعة], (SELECT SUM(p2.payment_amount) FROM payments p2 WHERE p2.pos_number = payments.pos_number)-3000 AS [قيمة الاقساط المدفوعة], [tblinstallments].[installments]-Count([payments].[payment_date])+1 AS [عدد الأقساط المتبقية], tblinstallments.finalunitprice-(SELECT SUM(p2.payment_amount) FROM payments p2 WHERE p2.pos_number = payments.pos_number) AS [المبلغ المتبقي], (SELECT SUM(p2.payment_amount) FROM payments p2 WHERE p2.pos_number = payments.pos_number) AS [اجمالي ما تم دفعه] FROM payments INNER JOIN tblinstallments ON payments.pos_number = tblinstallments.pos WHERE (((payments.payment_reason) Like "*قسط*")) GROUP BY payments.pos_number, tblinstallments.installments, tblinstallments.unitprice, tblinstallments.finalunitprice, tblinstallments.monthlyinstallmentprice ORDER BY payments.pos_number;  --------------------------------------------------

wholesalers_and_other_projects.sql: PARAMETERS [ادخل الشهر المطلوب عرض استبدال الماكينات خلاله] Long; SELECT Temp_transfer.POSCode, Temp_transfer.OldPOS, Temp_transfer.NewPOS, Year([Transfer_Date]) AS Expr1, Month([transfer_date]) AS Expr2, Temp_transfer.Notes, Temp_transfer.OldType FROM Temp_transfer WHERE Temp_transfer.Transfer_Date >= DateSerial( Year(Date()), [ادخل الشهر المطلوب عرض استبدال الماكينات خلاله], 1 ) AND Temp_transfer.Transfer_Date < DateAdd( "m", 1, DateSerial( Year(Date()), [ادخل الشهر المطلوب عرض استبدال الماكينات خلاله], 1 ) );  --------------------------------------------------

wholesalers_and_other_projects.name: query_issues_dates
wholesalers_and_other_projects.sql: SELECT T.GrocerName AS [اسم المخبز], T.POSN AS [رقم الماكينة], T.IssueDate AS [تاريخ حدوث العطل], T.NoteG AS [تفاصيل العطل], T.ActionDate AS [تاريخ اصلاح العطل], Q.FaultCount AS [عدد مرات حدوث العطل], T.ActionType FROM [TransAction] AS T INNER JOIN (SELECT TransAction.GrocerName, TransAction.POSN, Count(*) AS FaultCount FROM TransAction WHERE TransAction.ActionType = "اصلاح عطل" AND TransAction.IssueDate >= DateValue(Forms!frm_query_issues!txtfromdate) AND TransAction.IssueDate < DateAdd( "d", 1, DateValue(Forms!frm_query_issues!txttodate) ) GROUP BY TransAction.GrocerName, TransAction.POSN )  AS Q ON (T.POSN = Q.POSN) AND (T.GrocerName = Q.GrocerName) WHERE T.ActionType = "اصلاح عطل" AND T.IssueDate >= DateValue(Forms!frm_query_issues!txtfromdate) AND T.IssueDate < DateAdd( "d", 1, DateValue(Forms!frm_query_issues!txttodate) ) ORDER BY T.IssueDate;  --------------------------------------------------

wholesalers_and_other_projects.name: query_on_the_GO
wholesalers_and_other_projects.sql: SELECT Assets.bkcode, Assets.Comments, Assets.POSID, Assets.[POS-ID_2], Assets.Cell_type, Assets.Cell_Serial, Assets.[cell_2-ser], Assets.[Cell_type-2], [pos1+2].POS FROM [pos1+2] INNER JOIN Assets ON ([pos1+2].bkcode = Assets.bkcode) AND ([pos1+2].POS = Assets.POS_2) WHERE (((Assets.bkcode) Like "*" & [ادخل كود المخبز المراد الاستعلام عنها] & "*") AND ((Assets.Comments) Like "*" & [ادخل اسم التاجر المراد الاستعلام عنه] & "*") AND (([pos1+2].POS) Like "*" & [ادخل رقم الماكينة المراد الاستعلام عنها] & "*"));  --------------------------------------------------
